topics.title: Stern & Byrne Discuss MTV Awards
topics.summary: Howard Stern and Howard Byrne discuss their confusion over artists like George Michael and Barry Manilow during the recent MTV Awards broadcast. They also comment on Richard Lewis’s appearance and reference Bosco cereal's hat-shaped toy, discussing its design.”” 54 words.

topics.title: Lewis and Hall Clash Over MTV Awards
topics.summary: Richard Lewis recounts a chaotic interview with Arsenio Hall during his stand-up debut, detailing an uncomfortable exchange where Hall questioned him about women and then launched into criticisms of Hall’s behavior at the MTV awards show, including perceived bias against Black performers. The conversation devolved to accusations that Hall was inappropriately dismissive of musical talent.

topics.title: Casting Calls and Arnold Schwarzenegger
topics.summary: The broadcast focuses on a phone call campaign to find ball girls for a tennis competition, followed by an attempt to contact Arnold Schwarzenegger about judging the Miss America pageant. Robin Quiver’s activities playing tennis with a friend while Howard is working are discussed, alongside concerns regarding Gary's alleged scams.

topics.title: Hypnosis, Steam Pipes, Drug Dealers, and Theater Violence
topics.summary: During the broadcast, discussions included beliefs regarding hypnotism, reports of steam pipe failures causing power outages in Gramercy Park alongside concerns about asbestos contamination. The conversation shifted to a court case involving Jim Baker’s mental state and his unusual perceptions, followed by updates on an extradition hearing for a Colombian drug dealer. Finally, they discussed a violent incident at a theater where a man threatened actress Justine Bateman.

topics.title: Frank Sinatra, Bing’s Alzheimer & MTV Drama
topics.summary:
